about: The semantic model of the corrugator records (issue #117): what the plant measures, how each measure aggregates, and which dimensions slice it, in the plant's own words. A question is a structured request, measure x group_by x filters x window, that semantic.py validates against this file and compiles to parameterized DuckDB SQL. The model never holds a number of the records: every value is computed by DuckDB from the record store when a request runs. Physical table and column names live only in the `physical` block, so a renamed store column (record contract v2, issue #100) changes that block and nothing else.
standard: Shaped like dbt MetricFlow's semantic models and Cube's data schema: entities with a primary key and many-to-one joins, dimensions (categorical, and time at a grain), measures with an aggregation (sum, count, count_distinct), and metrics built from them (ratio: a ratio of two summed measures, never an average of ratios; priced: a quantity priced once through cost_model at the named, assumed rates). One list holds both measures and metrics, as Cube's measures do; `agg` says which.

physical.about: The one block that names the store's tables and columns (record_store.TABLES). Every other block names logical columns as {placeholders}. A column maps to a physical column or to an expression over its own table's columns; null means the store does not carry it yet, and a dimension or measure that reads it is refused with that reason. `where` keeps an entity to some of its table's rows: its columns compared with literals (=, <>, <, >, <=, >=, IN, IS NULL), combined with AND, OR, NOT and parentheses; its literals are bound as parameters when it compiles. `id` names each row's record in a receipt: a stop's id, a setup's, a reject or lane line's own identity.

columns.good_sqft: gross_sqft - trim_sqft - shear_sqft - reject_sqft - changeover_sqft - cutoff_waste_sqft - stacker_waste_sqft - admin_sqft

entities.name: setup
entities.label: Run setup
entities.description: One dry-end run setup: the fact table. Its order lanes, reject lines and stops hang off it.

entities.name: stop
entities.label: Stop
entities.description: One row of the downtime log, held by the run setup it fell in.

entities.name: reject
entities.label: Reject line
entities.description: One lane's rejected board on a setup, by reject family and reason.

entities.name: lane
entities.label: Order lane
entities.description: One order's slice of the web on a setup: lane N, its outs and cuts.

entities.name: shift
entities.label: Shift
entities.description: One 480-minute shift of a production day, with its crew and the bale's scale reading.

dimensions.name: day
dimensions.label: Production day
dimensions.description: The production day: starts 07:00 and carries its start date, Monday to Friday.

dimensions.name: week
dimensions.label: Production week
dimensions.description: The Monday-to-Friday production week, named by its Monday.

dimensions.name: month
dimensions.label: Calendar month
dimensions.description: The calendar month, named by its first day.

dimensions.name: period
dimensions.label: 4-4-5 period
dimensions.description: The 4-4-5 accounting period (52-week years of periods of four, four and five weeks), named by its first Monday.

dimensions.name: shift
dimensions.label: Shift
dimensions.description: Shift 1, 2 or 3 of the production day, 480 minutes each.

dimensions.name: crew
dimensions.label: Crew
dimensions.description: The crew on shift (a synthetic crew label, not a person).

dimensions.name: grade
dimensions.label: Board grade (quality ID)
dimensions.description: The board grade the setup ran, its quality ID: 26-C, 32-C, 55-C, 200-C single wall, 275-BC and 275-EB double wall.

dimensions.name: flute
dimensions.label: Flute
dimensions.description: The flute profile of the grade: C single wall, BC and EB double wall.

dimensions.name: wet_end
dimensions.label: Paper run (wet end)
dimensions.description: The paper run the setup belongs to: consecutive setups on one grade and web width. A paper change starts a new one.

dimensions.name: web_width
dimensions.label: Web width (in)
dimensions.description: The paper width the setup ran on, in inches.

dimensions.name: kind
dimensions.label: Stop kind
dimensions.description: The stop's category: Maintenance, Operator, planned maintenance (scheduled time), or External (a power outage, outside the plant, whatever kind the record gives it).

dimensions.name: place
dimensions.label: Stop place
dimensions.description: Where on the machine the stop was logged: Splicer 1-5, Single facer, Double backer, Glue dams, Steam system, Slitter/scorer, Upper, Lower and Shear knife, Stacker, Power.

dimensions.name: reason
dimensions.label: Stop reason
dimensions.description: The reason logged for the stop: missed splice, knife / slitter jam, stacker, raw material, order change, glue / starch, steam / moisture, power outage, other; planned maintenance for a scheduled stop.

dimensions.name: reject_family
dimensions.label: Reject family
dimensions.description: The dry-end reject family a line is counted in: bond, warp, misalignment, moisture, other (cracking and surface, handling damage, paper and mill, print).

dimensions.name: reject_reason
dimensions.label: Reject reason
dimensions.description: The reason recorded under the family, from the reject taxonomy (reject_reasons.json): delamination or blisters under bond, up, down, twist or S warp, wet board or wet edges under moisture, and so on.

dimensions.name: lane
dimensions.label: Lane (cutoff knife)
dimensions.description: Lane N across the web, cut by cutoff knife N and stacked at stacker N.

dimensions.name: order
dimensions.label: Order
dimensions.description: The order a lane ran (SO- and the production day). An order can run in several setups, so its lines repeat.

dimensions.name: customer
dimensions.label: Customer
dimensions.description: The customer an order lane is cut for.

measures.name: setups
measures.label: Setups
measures.description: Run setup records: a setup continuing across a shift boundary is a record in each shift.

measures.name: order_changes
measures.label: Order changes
measures.description: Setups an order change started (change code O): the knife order combination changed. Shift splits (S) and continuations are the other setups.
measures.tool: none on this store yet (a count of the setup records)

measures.name: paper_changes
measures.label: Paper changes
measures.description: Distinct paper runs (wet ends) the setups belong to: each starts with a paper change.

measures.name: production_days
measures.label: Production days
measures.description: Production days that hold at least one setup record.

measures.name: lineal_ft
measures.label: Lineal feet
measures.description: Board run as lineal feet, the shear chops included.

measures.name: lineal_per_setup
measures.label: Lineal per setup
measures.description: Lineal feet over setup records: the run length of a setup.

measures.name: lineal_per_paper_change
measures.label: Lineal per paper change
measures.description: Lineal feet over distinct paper runs: the run length between paper changes.

measures.name: gross_sqft
measures.label: Gross area
measures.description: Board produced: web width x lineal feet / 12, before any waste.

measures.name: msf
measures.label: Volume
measures.description: Gross area in thousands of square feet.

measures.name: msf_per_day
measures.label: Volume per production day
measures.description: MSF over the production days that ran: comparable between windows of unequal days.

measures.name: setups_above_trim_target
measures.label: Setups over the trim flag
measures.description: Setup records whose own side trim, as a percent of their gross, is over the owner's trim flag.

measures.name: trim_sqft
measures.label: Side trim
measures.description: Side trim: the web left either side of the lanes, over the order travel.

measures.name: trim_pct
measures.label: Side trim
measures.description: Side trim as a percent of gross: always the largest waste percentage; the order mix and its web widths decide it.

measures.name: shear_sqft
measures.label: Shear chops
measures.description: The shear chops: full-web cuts at order and grade changes, part of gross.

measures.name: shear_pct
measures.label: Shear
measures.description: Shear chops as a percent of gross; controllable through sequencing.

measures.name: changeover_sqft
measures.label: Changeover rejects
measures.description: Board rejected at order, paper and flute changes: counted with shear and sequencing, never dry-end quality.

measures.name: cutoff_waste_sqft
measures.label: Cutoff-knife waste boards
measures.description: Boards lost at each lane's cutoff knife at an order change.

measures.name: stacker_waste_sqft
measures.label: Stacker waste boards
measures.description: Boards lost at each lane's stacker at an order change.

measures.name: admin_sqft
measures.label: Planning / admin entries
measures.description: Planning and admin entries (order fill, over scheduled and the like): reported apart, not production waste.

measures.name: yield_sqft
measures.label: Yield after trim and shear
measures.description: Gross minus side trim minus shear: the denominator of dry-end waste.

measures.name: good_output_sqft
measures.label: Good output
measures.description: The saleable board: gross minus every recorded waste line but the bale (side trim, shear, changeover rejects, the cutoff-knife and stacker waste boards, dry-end and planning / admin).

measures.name: reject_sqft
measures.label: Dry-end rejects
measures.description: Rejected board at the dry end, square feet, by family and reason: the dry-end quality lines, never changeover or planning / admin; controllable through temperatures.
measures.tool: get_quality_breakdown rejected_sqft; get_waste_breakdown bond/warp/misalignment/moisture sqft and details

measures.name: reject_sheets
measures.label: Rejected sheets
measures.description: Rejected sheets at the dry end.

measures.name: dry_end_pct
measures.label: Dry-end rejects
measures.description: Dry-end rejects as a percent of the yield after trim and shear. Sliced by a reject family, reason or lane, each slice is read against the whole yield, so the families add up to the total.

measures.name: maintenance_pm_minutes
measures.label: Maintenance and planned maintenance
measures.description: Minutes stopped for maintenance, unplanned and planned together (the Scheduled kind is planned maintenance).

measures.name: maintenance_pm_pct
measures.label: Maintenance + PM downtime
measures.description: Maintenance and planned-maintenance minutes as a percent of scheduled minutes.

measures.name: op_maint_minutes
measures.label: Operator and maintenance downtime
measures.description: Minutes stopped by operators and for unplanned maintenance: the controllable downtime the owner's combined band reads.

measures.name: op_maint_pct
measures.label: Downtime (operator and maintenance)
measures.description: Operator and unplanned maintenance minutes as a percent of scheduled minutes, against the owner's combined band.

measures.name: stops
measures.label: Stops
measures.description: Rows of the downtime log.
measures.tool: get_period_kpis stops; get_downtime_pareto stops; get_downtime_breakdown stops

measures.name: downtime_minutes
measures.label: Downtime
measures.description: Minutes stopped.
measures.tool: get_downtime_pareto minutes; get_downtime_breakdown down_minutes; get_period_kpis downtime_minutes

measures.name: minutes_per_stop
measures.label: Minutes per stop
measures.description: Minutes stopped over stops: how long a stop lasts.

measures.name: scheduled_minutes
measures.label: Scheduled minutes
measures.description: Scheduled shift minutes: 480 a shift, the denominator of downtime and speed with stops.

measures.name: downtime_pct
measures.label: Downtime
measures.description: Minutes stopped as a percent of scheduled minutes. Sliced by stop kind, place or reason, each slice is read against all the window's scheduled minutes; maintenance and operator downtime each have the owner's band.

measures.name: elapsed_minutes
measures.label: Setup clock
measures.description: Minutes on the setups' own clocks, stops included.

measures.name: running_minutes
measures.label: Running minutes
measures.description: Minutes on the setups' clocks with their stops taken out.

measures.name: target_ft
measures.label: Feet at grade target
measures.description: The feet each setup would have run at its grade's target speed over its clock.

measures.name: target_run_ft
measures.label: Feet at grade target, running
measures.description: The feet each setup would have run at its grade's target speed over its running minutes.

measures.name: speed_run_fpm
measures.label: Speed without stops
measures.description: Lineal feet over running minutes: the speed the machine ran at while it ran.

measures.name: speed_elapsed_fpm
measures.label: Elapsed speed
measures.description: Lineal feet over the setups' own clocks, stops included.

measures.name: speed_all_fpm
measures.label: Speed with stops
measures.description: Lineal feet over scheduled minutes. Scheduled minutes carry no grade, place or order, so this speed slices only by time, shift and crew.

measures.name: speed_to_target_pct
measures.label: Speed against grade target
measures.description: Lineal feet over the feet each setup's grade target gives over its clock, stops included.

measures.name: run_speed_to_target_pct
measures.label: Running speed against grade target
measures.description: Lineal feet over the feet each setup's grade target gives over its running minutes: speed without stops against target.

measures.name: bale_sqft
measures.label: Bale (scale reading)
measures.description: The shift bale's scale reading: every waste line that reached the baler.

measures.name: bale_msf
measures.label: Baled waste (scale reading)
measures.description: The bales' scale readings in thousands of square feet.

measures.name: bale_pct
measures.label: Bale (scale reading)
measures.description: The bales' scale readings as a percent of gross. A bale is a shift's, so it slices by time, shift and crew only.

measures.name: unexplained_sqft
measures.label: Unexplained waste
measures.description: The bale's scale reading minus every waste line the shift recorded (side trim, shear, changeover, the waste boards, dry-end and planning / admin): waste no record accounts for.

measures.name: unexplained_pct
measures.label: Unexplained waste
measures.description: Unexplained waste as a percent of gross.

measures.name: sheets
measures.label: Sheets
measures.description: Sheets cut: actual cuts x outs, over the order lanes.

measures.name: nominal_sheets
measures.label: Scheduled sheets
measures.description: Sheets scheduled: nominal cuts x outs.

measures.name: actual_cuts
measures.label: Cuts
measures.description: Cuts as run.

measures.name: nominal_cuts
measures.label: Nominal cuts
measures.description: Cuts as scheduled.

measures.name: overrun_pct
measures.label: Over/under-run
measures.description: Actual cuts minus nominal cuts, as a percent of nominal: positive is overrun, negative underrun.

measures.name: overrun_cuts
measures.label: Cuts over nominal
measures.description: Actual cuts minus nominal cuts.

measures.name: trim_usd
measures.label: Side trim, priced
measures.description: Side trim priced as paper at the assumed paper rate (cost_model, rates.json): the records hold no costs.

measures.name: shear_usd
measures.label: Shear chops, priced
measures.description: Shear chops priced as waste board: paper plus the run time they took, at the assumed rates.

measures.name: dry_end_usd
measures.label: Dry-end rejects, priced
measures.description: Dry-end rejects priced as waste board: paper plus the run time they took, at the assumed rates.

measures.name: bale_usd
measures.label: Bale, priced
measures.description: The bales' scale readings priced as paper at the assumed paper rate.

measures.name: unexplained_usd
measures.label: Unexplained waste, priced
measures.description: Unexplained waste priced as paper at the assumed paper rate: the other waste of where the money went.

measures.name: downtime_usd
measures.label: Downtime, priced
measures.description: Minutes stopped priced as machine time at the assumed machine rate. Filtered to the order-change reason, it is the setups bucket of where the money went.
